token.label: API Token
token.description: You can obtain API token from [Account Settings](https://app.youform.com/account).

youform_list_forms.label: List Forms
youform_list_forms.description: Lists one page of forms in the account.

page.label: Page
page.description: Page number to return, starting at 1. Defaults to 1. Use the returned `current_page` and `last_page` to page through.

youform_list_submissions.label: List Submissions
youform_list_submissions.description: Lists one page of submissions for a form.

formSlug.label: Form Slug
formSlug.description: The form's slug, e.g. "kyir3qrg" (the `slug` field from List Forms, also the last part of the form's share link).

page.label: Page
page.description: Page number to return, starting at 1. Defaults to 1. Use the returned `current_page` and `last_page` to page through.

sortOrder.label: Sort Order
sortOrder.description: Order by submission time. Defaults to oldest first.

isComplete.label: Completion
isComplete.description: Complete or partial submissions only. Partial needs Pro. Unset returns all.
